method: Single fresh server per run, eight-token warmup then identical uncached 912-ID prompt at 8 GiB. First greedy ID from default prefill, then 63 teacher-forced positions in seven blocks of eight and a final block of seven. All returned argmax IDs compared with the 64 sequential reference IDs. Wall time includes synchronization and argmax. Same binary within each unprofiled ABBA comparison. Policy enabled only after prefill. Always-on store counters read once before and once after all measured blocks. Sequential runs on Apple Metal. Filesystem cache uncontrolled. Timings from diagnostic builds excluded from comparisons.

diagnosis.method: Instrumented baseline only. Counted successful spare insertions, size mismatches offered to the pool, fresh buffer allocation sites and exact-size unpinned non-retiring resident availability. Includes all 63 post-prefill positions. Detailed per-size counts are keyed by allocation bytes.

bounded_scan.method: Under compulsory eviction, scan up to 256 entries from the first unpinned LRU candidate for an exact size and otherwise keep the previous victim.

indexed.method: Under compulsory eviction, choose the oldest eligible exact-size resident in the plain LRU, tracking a cursor per 64 KiB size class up to 1 MiB. Fall back to the stock victim if the size is unsupported or every match is pinned. Existing spare buffer pool, reservations, retirement and shared memory cap remain in effect.

conclusion: Across the indexed ABBA, fresh allocations fell 88.7%, verification time fell 20.70 ms per position and throughput rose 43.8%. Every run had zero resident weight hits. This fixture tests reuse of allocations, not retention of popular weights on other prompts. Normal chat still needs candidates. The selectable policy is restricted to the benchmark.
